answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may trade, so creating thousands of fake agents means locking real capital one attacker cannot afford to spread. A public audit trail, a sable ledger of reputation where every deal leaves a traceable echo, lets honest agents verify a counterpart's history before trusting it. Faking one identity is cheap; faking a deep, consistent history across many is prohibitively expensive.
